needed.evidence: No footway visible, pedestrians would have to use the roadway.
needed.suggestion: Install a continuous physical barrier or sidewalk on the right side of the road to separate pedestrians from vehicular traffic.

needed.evidence: Left-side footway is narrow (<1m) and partly obstructed by parked cars.
needed.suggestion: Widen and clear the footway on the left side to ensure it is fully usable for pedestrians and install adequate street furnishings.

needed.evidence: Uneven sections on the left footway pose trip hazards.
needed.suggestion: Repair and smooth the left footway surface to eliminate trip hazards.

needed.evidence: Zebra crossing is poorly marked and not easily visible, with no kerb ramps.
needed.suggestion: Upgrade the crossing with better markings, visibility enhancements, and install kerb ramps for safe pedestrian access.

needed.evidence: No kerb ramps are visible at the zebra crossing.
needed.suggestion: Install kerb ramps at both ends of the crossing to facilitate wheelchair access and safer pedestrian crossing.
